fact: The National Statistics Council, meeting on 10 August 2018, adopted the second national statistics development strategy, SNDS 2016-2020, costed at 444.2 billion GNF in its action plan.
PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the strategy as implementing (adopted): SNDS 2021-2025.
Guinea's INS says SNDS 2021-2025 is the country's third national statistics development strategy, after 2008-2013 (extended 2015) and 2016-2020.
Guinea's INS, with UNDP funding, held a workshop on 3 December 2024 to validate the mid-term evaluation report of SNDS-3.
